description: Documentation updates: docs/architecture.md Phase 5 section, docs/setup.md opencv dep + perception CLI, README.md status/structure/features/roadmap/test count updates. Independent of FEAT-002 but ordered after it so the final test count is known.
steps: Step 1: Update docs/architecture.md — add a new '## Phase 5 — Perception (Camera + OpenCV)' section after the Phase 4 section (before '## Design Principles'). Content per the design doc §2.12: Camera Rendering subsection (PerceptionPipeline uses mujoco.Renderer, programmatic camera via azimuth/elevation/distance/lookat, 640x480 RGB + depth, headless), Perception Module table (PerceptionPipeline, ColorDetector, Detection, PerceptionResult, PerceptionPolicy), Detection Pipeline numbered steps (render RGB+depth, RGB->HSV, color masks, contours, unproject, return PerceptionResult), Integration subsection (Runner perception=True, Recorder frames, PerceptionPolicy wrapper), CLI subsection (forge_perception.py examples). Also update the overview sentence and 'current implementation covers' line to mention Phase 5.

Step 2: Update docs/setup.md — in Step 2 'Install Python Dependencies', add 'opencv-python-headless' to the pip install command. Add a new '## Perception' section after the existing 'Replay Recorded Runs' section with usage examples for forge_perception.py (--render, --detect, --detect --annotate, custom camera params).

Step 3: Update README.md:
  (a) Change status line from 'Phase 4 — Failure Injection' to 'Phase 5 — Perception (Camera + OpenCV)'.
  (b) Update the description paragraph: 'Phases 1–5 are complete: simulation foundation, task evaluation, telemetry/replay, chaos testing, and camera-based perception.'
  (c) Add to 'What's included' bullets: '- **Perception** — MuJoCo offscreen camera rendering, OpenCV HSV color detection, depth-based 3D position estimation'
  (d) In Project Structure, add 'perception.py' line under forge_core/ and 'forge_perception.py' line under scripts/.
  (e) In Quick Start Install, add 'opencv-python-headless' to the pip install line.
  (f) Add a 'Perception' subsection in Quick Start after Chaos testing with example commands.
  (g) Update Verify section: change '88 tests' to the actual final count (run pytest --co -q to get it).
  (h) In Phase Roadmap table, change Phase 5 status from '—' to 'Done'.
  (i) Update the Running Tests section test count comment if present.
Step 4: Run python3 -m pytest tests/ --co -q to get the final test count and make sure the count in README.md matches.
acceptance_criteria: docs/architecture.md contains a Phase 5 section with PerceptionPipeline, ColorDetector, Detection, PerceptionResult, PerceptionPolicy
docs/setup.md mentions opencv-python-headless in install commands and has perception CLI examples
README.md phase roadmap shows Phase 5 as Done
README.md project structure lists perception.py and forge_perception.py
README.md test count matches actual passing test count
All tests still pass after doc changes
findings: All 3 doc files updated. 117 tests pass. Phase 5 section added to architecture.md, opencv-python-headless added to setup.md, README.md updated with Phase 5 status/structure/features/roadmap/test count.
